about: Declares every file of the Gemini Task texts and every {{placeholder}} in them with its source (spec acceptance 2). tests/unit/test_gemini_task_texts.py checks it against the files. An export with an unfilled placeholder fails. Text between <!-- and --> in a pack file is an operator note: the exporter strips it before the file goes to Drive.
placeholder_syntax: {{name}}; {{bp:<rule>.<threshold>}} for a registry number, with an optional |percent after it
never_words_note: The preset's never_words are checked in every MESSAGE and CLAUSE block outside a never phrase (acceptance 1).

episode_id.source: episode.json of the episode folder (`episodes/<id>/`), key id

episode_title.source: episode.json of the episode folder (`episodes/<id>/`), key title

era_line.source: the episode's one era sentence in `episodes/<id>/episode.json` (key `era_line`), written to the preset's `era_line_shape`: "The world is <era>: the only light sources are <list>, and everything is made of <materials>." One sentence, no never-word (GC-22)

sha8.source: first 8 hex of the sha256 of the artefact the message is about (the text, the queue, the batch's blocks or the assembled prompts); computed by the exporter (A2) when it renders the message

review_sha8.source: the sha8 in the REVIEW line being answered (P4)

round.source: count of full checks of this stage (P1-P3), or R1/R2 for P6; computed by the exporter (A2) when it renders the message

batch_no.source: number of the batch in the episode's batch plan (0 for T0)

batch_total.source: number of batches in the plan

batch_size.source: pictures per batch: six until the T0 record sets another number (spec section 6)

redo_total.source: number of redo batches in the redo list

n.source: number of pictures, blocks or queue entries in this message

round_note.source: the R1 or R2 sentence in the operator notes of P6, chosen by the exporter

drive_root.source: the Drive folder of the project, set once per project in the Gemini task settings (never a link with a key)

attached_list.source: file names of the references to attach, in attach order, one list per message; computed by the exporter (A2) when it renders the message

picture_blocks.source: one block per picture in the format of PROMPT_CLAUSES.md (id, target, references, verbatim prompt); computed by the exporter (A2) when it renders the message

picture_ids.source: the batch's picture ids, comma separated, in queue order (P8)

first_missing_id.source: the first id the last BATCH REPORT marks NOT MADE (P9)

shot_list_json.source: the video script's shot list as JSON, from the episode's production script

replies.source: Claude's one-line answer per finding (P4 notes describe the form)

revised_text.source: the revised artefact after the accepted changes, or the line NO CHANGE (P4)

hero_text.source: the hero's verbatim registry text (age, build, skin, hair, face, garment, prop; HI-01, HI-02, HI-05)

pack_version.source: the pack version string written at export (pack date plus short commit)

repo_commit.source: git commit the pack was exported from

style_preset_id.source: the episode's look: episode.json look.id, default `default_style_profile` in config/visual_style_presets.json

never_words.source: config/visual_style_presets.json, preset `style_preset_id`, key `never_words` (rendered as a list)

always_list.source: config/visual_style_presets.json, preset `style_preset_id`, key `always` (rendered as a list)

pictures_per_day.source: config/visual_style_presets.json, preset `style_preset_id`, key `pictures_per_day`, or `chat_pictures_per_day` in episode.json

style_pack_table.source: the style pack table of the exporter: type, file, sha256, the shot sizes that use it

BP-105.nominal_narrator_share.format: percent (0.7 is written 70 %, with `|percent` after the key)
